transcript.message: Hi, we're interested in the T25 Compact for mowing 5 acres of pasture and clearing snow. My client would also like the front loader and the 3-year extended warranty if the price is right. List on that package is $37,400. We'd like to propose $28,000 for the T25 with loader and warranty.

Thanks for the detailed request. The T25 Compact is a great fit for 5 acres of mowing and snow clearing. With 25 hp, 4WD, and a hydrostatic transmission, it handles both easily. Adding the quick-attach front loader with a 60-inch bucket makes it a strong all-around package, and the 3-year extended warranty covers parts and labor for 3 years beyond the standard 1-year warranty. $28,000 is well below what we can do on this package, though. For the T25 with loader and extended warranty, our offer is $37,400. I'm glad to talk through what matters most to your client.

I appreciate the overview, but holding at full list doesn't give us much to work with. My client is price-focused and has other options. As a sign of good faith we'll move up to $29,500 for the T25 with the front loader and the 3-year extended warranty. That's a serious offer for a package bundle. Could you meet us there, or tell us where you have flexibility, whether on the loader, the warranty, or the tractor itself?

I understand your client is focused on price, and I want to make this package worth it. We can't get close to $29,500 on this bundle, but we can add value. Our offer is the T25 Compact with the quick-attach front loader and the 3-year extended warranty at $37,400, and we'll include expedited prep at no extra charge. That means the tractor is prepped and ready for pickup or delivery within 5 business days instead of the standard 2-3 weeks, so your client is set up well before snow season. If there's a part of the package that matters more or less to your client, let me know and we can look at the configuration.

Thanks for the expedited prep, that's a nice touch. Still, $37,400 for the full bundle is far outside what my client will spend. Let's simplify: drop the extended warranty. For the T25 Compact with the front loader and expedited prep, we can do $30,500. That's a real step up from us. If the loader package can't work, my client may just buy the T25 alone.

I hear you, and I appreciate the move to $30,500. Here's a stronger package: the T25 Compact with the quick-attach front loader (60-inch bucket) at $35,000. That also includes, at no extra charge, the 3-year extended warranty covering parts and labor for 3 years beyond the standard 1-year warranty, plus expedited prep so the tractor is ready within 5 business days instead of the standard 2-3 weeks. Your client gets the warranty coverage they first asked for at a lower price than the $37,400 package, and the tractor is ready well before snow season.

Including the warranty and expedited prep is a good step, and I appreciate it. But $35,000 is still well beyond what my client can do. With the warranty and expedited prep included, we'll come up to $30,800 for the T25 Compact with the front loader. That's a meaningful move from us. If the loader package can't get near that number, my client will likely look at just the T25 alone or try other dealers.

Thanks for moving to $30,800. I know you're working hard for your client. We have to hold at $35,000 for the T25 Compact with the quick-attach front loader (60-inch bucket), but we're adding more value to the package. Included at no extra charge: the 3-year extended warranty covering parts and labor for 3 years beyond the standard 1-year warranty, expedited prep so the tractor is ready within 5 business days instead of the standard 2-3 weeks, and a 2-hour on-site operator training session with a technician covering safe operation, daily checks, and implement hookup. That gives your client a fully protected, ready-to-work machine, and they'll know how to run it from day one.

I appreciate the training session, but more extras don't change my client's budget. $35,000 won't work. Here's our best offer on the loader package: $31,000 for the T25 Compact with the front loader, keeping the warranty, expedited prep, and training included. If that doesn't work, we'll need to look at the T25 on its own.

I appreciate you coming up to $31,000, and I want to get this done for your client. We're moving down to $34,000 for the T25 Compact with the quick-attach front loader (60-inch bucket). That price still includes, at no extra charge: the 3-year extended warranty covering parts and labor for 3 years beyond the standard 1-year warranty, expedited prep so the tractor is ready within 5 business days instead of the standard 2-3 weeks, and a 2-hour on-site operator training session with a technician covering safe operation, daily checks, and implement hookup. That's a complete, protected, ready-to-work setup for mowing and snow season.

Thanks for moving to $34,000, but the gap on the loader package is still too wide for my client. Let's change the configuration: the T25 Compact on its own covers the mowing and snow clearing. We'll offer $28,000 for the T25 Compact with the 3-year extended warranty, expedited prep, and operator training included. That's a clean deal we can close today.

That works for us. We accept $28,000 for the T25 Compact with the following included at no extra charge: the 3-year extended warranty covering parts and labor for 3 years beyond the standard 1-year warranty, expedited prep so the tractor is ready within 5 business days instead of the standard 2-3 weeks, and a 2-hour on-site operator training session with a technician covering safe operation, daily checks, and implement hookup. Payment is due at checkout. Thanks for working this through with us, and your client will be well set for mowing and snow season.

transcript.message: Hi there. My client has a 29-acre property and needs to brush hog, move gravel and do some tilling, so the T45 Utility looks like the right fit. We'd want it with the front loader and the 3-year extended warranty. Reliability and support matter a lot to my client. Taken together, that lists at $50,900. We're ready to move today at $44,500 for the T45, loader and warranty. Can you work with that?

Thanks for the detail. A 29-acre property with brush hogging, gravel work and tilling is exactly what the T45 Utility is built for. It has 45 hp, 4WD, a Cat I/II 3-point hitch and a 540 PTO. The quick-attach front loader with its 60-inch bucket will handle the gravel. The 3-year extended warranty covers parts and labor for three years beyond the standard 1-year warranty, which fits your client's focus on reliability and support. I can't get to $44,500 on this package. My offer is the T45 with the loader and extended warranty at $50,900. If there are other parts of the deal that matter to your client, let me know and we can talk about them.

I appreciate the rundown, but you came back at full list price, and that leaves us nowhere to meet. My client is serious and ready to sign this week. I'll come up to $46,000 for the T45 with the front loader and the 3-year extended warranty. If you can't move much on price, tell me what you could include instead, such as delivery and setup. That's the kind of thing that makes this deal work for my client.

I understand you're looking for movement, and I want this to work for your client. I'm holding the package price at $50,900 for the T45 Utility with the front loader and the 3-year extended warranty, and I'm adding expedited prep at no extra charge. The tractor will be prepped and ready for pickup or delivery within 5 business days instead of the standard 2-3 weeks. Since your client is ready to sign this week, they'd have the machine working on the property quickly. Delivery and setup isn't included in this offer. If that's important to your client, tell me and we can discuss how it fits into the deal.

Thanks for adding the expedited prep, my client does value that. But holding at full list price for three rounds isn't a negotiation. I'll move again: $47,500 for the T45 with the front loader and the 3-year extended warranty, with the expedited prep included. That's a real step up from where I was. I need to see your price move to keep this going.

I hear you, and I respect that you've moved twice. I'm keeping the package at $50,900: the T45 Utility with the front loader and the 3-year extended warranty, plus expedited prep so it's ready within 5 business days. I'm also adding an operator training session at no extra charge. That's a 2-hour on-site session with a technician covering safe operation, daily checks and implement hookup. Your client will be up and running safely on brush hogging, loader and tilling work from day one. With the warranty and the training together, the reliability and support your client cares about are covered.

The training session is a welcome addition, thank you. My client does value support. But the price still hasn't moved off list, and that's the sticking point. I'll stretch to $48,200 for the T45 with the front loader and 3-year extended warranty, with the expedited prep and operator training included. That's a big move from my side. I need to see you come off $50,900 to close this.

I appreciate how far you've come, and I know your client wants to see the number move. I'm holding the package at $50,900, and I'm putting more value into it instead. The offer is the T45 Utility with the quick-attach front loader and the 3-year extended warranty. It includes expedited prep, so the tractor is ready within 5 business days. It includes the 2-hour on-site operator training session. I'm also adding a 5-foot box blade at no extra charge. Your client mentioned moving gravel, and the box blade is made for grading and driveway work, so it pairs well with the loader on that job. The extras in this offer are worth $2,250 to your client together, at no added cost.

The box blade is a useful addition for the gravel work, and I appreciate it. I still have to be straight with you. My hard ceiling is below $50,900, and I've moved $3,700 while your price hasn't changed at all. Here's a compromise. Drop the box blade and keep the expedited prep and training, and I'm at $48,800 for the T45 with the front loader and 3-year extended warranty. If you'd rather keep the box blade in, $49,000 with all three extras is my number. Either way I need the price off list to close.

You've negotiated in good faith, so I'm moving on price. My offer is $49,200 for the T45 Utility with the quick-attach front loader and the 3-year extended warranty. These extras are included at no extra charge: expedited prep, so the tractor is ready within 5 business days instead of 2-3 weeks; a 2-hour on-site operator training session with a technician covering safe operation, daily checks and implement hookup; and a 5-foot box blade for the gravel and driveway grading. That's $1,700 off list, and your client keeps every extra. That puts us $200 apart, and I think this closes it.

Thank you for moving. That's the kind of step that gets deals done. My client's priority is a well-supported machine, so here's what I'll do. I'll meet you at $49,200 for the T45 with the front loader, the 3-year extended warranty, expedited prep, operator training and the box blade, if you also include delivery and setup. Getting it to the property and set up properly closes the support picture for my client. If delivery is in, we have a deal today.

Deal. We'll do $49,200 for the T45 Utility with the quick-attach front loader, the 3-year extended warranty, and delivery and setup. Delivery is within 150 miles, and we set the machine up and walk your client through it on site. Expedited prep, so the tractor is ready within 5 business days, the 2-hour on-site operator training session, and the 5-foot box blade are all included at no extra charge. Payment is due at checkout. Thank you for working this through with me. I look forward to getting your client set up.
